# Entities and Products

## Overview
This wiki page outlines the [fictional universe](./fictional-universe.md) and [sample domain](./sample-domain.md) utilized for stress-[testing](./testing.md) the compiler. It details the various fictional companies, recurring characters, products, competitors, and intentional contradictions embedded within the [sample data](./sample-data.md) to exercise cross-linking, analytics, and human review systems.

## Key Details
* **Fictional Universe Purpose**: Designed strictly for compiler stress-testing, encompassing invented characters and corporate entities.
* **Featured Companies**:
  * **[Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md)** (`aurora`): Focuses on open [IoT](./iot.md) mesh [sensors](./sensors.md). Key products include the [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md) and [MeshSync protocol](./meshsync-protocol.md).
  * **[TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md)** (`teabuddy`): Specializes in [BLE](./ble.md) smart tea timers, featuring the [TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md) and an accompanying [iOS](./ios.md) app.
  * **[Nova Health](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)** (`nova-health`): Develops clinical wearables, notably the PulsePatch.
  * **GreenGrid Energy** (`greengrid`): Operates in home energy mesh systems with the GreenGrid Hub.
* **Recurring Characters**:
  * *[Mira Chen](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)* ([Firmware](./firmware.md) lead, Aurora Labs)
  * *Jonah Park* ([Hardware](./hardware.md), Aurora Labs)
  * *Sam Rivera* (Firmware, TeaBuddy)
  * *Alex Kim* (UX / interviews, TeaBuddy)
  * *Jamie Lo* (QA, TeaBuddy)
  * *Elena Voss, Priya Nair, Marcus Webb, Tina Okonkwo, Dev Singh* (Various roles from the procedural generator cast)
* **Products and Competitors**:
  * **[Nova Widget / Nova Widget v2](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)**: Aurora Labs soil moisture and temperature sensor featuring a pebble enclosure.
  * **MeshSync**: Aurora's local mesh protocol requiring no mandatory cloud connection.
  * **TeaBuddy Puck**: TeaBuddy timer powered by a CR2032 battery with BLE, haptic, and LED features.
  * **[SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md)**: A competitor product featuring an IP67 rating, a subscription model, and [LoRaWAN](./lorawan.md).
  * **GreenGrid Hub**: GreenGrid Energy product reserved for exploratory integration only.
  * **PulsePatch**: Nova Health clinical wearable which shares no firmware with MeshSync.
